# One "<id> <sha256-hex>" pair per line: the floor of
# engine/tests/fixtures/matching_golden.yaml. The hash covers each case's
# `spotify`, `collection` and `expected_status` fields (sha256 of their
# json.dumps(sort_keys=True) encoding) -- everything that actually drives the
# matching engine and the pass/fail assertion, not free-text fields like
# `description`.
#
# FR-009 / project rule 7: the Golden Set is only ever extended, never
# weakened. Every id below must always still exist in matching_golden.yaml
# with the SAME hash; a case can be added to that file without touching this
# one, but removing or renaming a case id, or editing its spotify/collection/
# expected_status fields in place, fails test_golden_set_only_ever_grows in
# engine/tests/test_matching_golden.py -- an in-place edit is indistinguishable
# from silently weakening the set otherwise (phase-7 review finding: an id
# check alone missed exactly this, and the fixture history shows it already
# happened once for stub-fuzzy-review-tier's title, before this hash existed).
# Append new "<id> <hash>" pairs here in the SAME commit that adds the case to
# matching_golden.yaml, never before or separately.
